transcript.text: Which region is the quiet region? Answer with the region name.

args.sql:
select c.region, count(*) as order_count
from memory.bench.orders o
join memory.bench.customers c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
group by c.region
order by order_count asc

transcript.text:
North has the fewest orders (259), matching the "quiet region" definition (region with fewest orders).

FINAL ANSWER: North
